# Sticker test fixtures

These three tiny images were drawn specifically for WeaveText's tests using geometric shapes. No upstream sticker collection or copyrighted meme asset is bundled. `animated.gif` and `animated.webp` contain two frames; `sample.png` is static. Licensed under this repository's Apache-2.0 license.

The copies under `android/app/src/androidTest/assets/stickers/` allow device tests to read the same originals from a separate test-package content provider.
